title: OB1 Collector long WakeUp
symptom: After updating OnePlus 8T to OxygenOS 12, the OB1 Collector has a very long wake-up time, causing missing readings (pattern of 3 readings, one missing, 3 readings). Manually restarting the collector works.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. It is speculated that changes in the Android kernel or OxygenOS 12 power management prevent xDrip from operating in the background, but no conclusive cause is identified.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. Suggestions include excluding xDrip from power saving options, allowing background activity, and disabling Bluetooth battery optimization, but the user reports these did not resolve the issue. No code change or setting is confirmed to fix it.
evidence_quote: I Updated my OnePlus 8T to the OxygenOS 12, and since the Update, the OB1 Collector has a very long WakeUp Time. So there are 3 Readings, one missing, and Three Readings again.
